title: Coordinate action of the Boolean cube equivalence
statement: For every Boolean vector $w$ of length $n$ and every coordinate $i$, the $i$th coordinate of its image in the $n$-dimensional cube over $\mathbb F_2$ is the image of the Boolean value $w_i$ under the standard equivalence between Boolean values and $\mathbb F_2$.
hypotheses_covered: w is a Boolean vector of length n
